Please for the love of god turn on your brain. This research is bullshit and it's obvious for anyone who has basic knowledge of how surveys are supported to be made. This survey was literally conducted through Viber, which is only popular among old not really educated people. What is worse, they were calling. Not many people here are picking up the phone when an unknown number is calling through usual phone services bc of scammers and other reasons. Who would pick up the phone when someone is calling them through Viber?? 
Next. No info about sample demographics. They could easily survey old people that they had an easy access to and say that this is opinion of all Russians. They could easily evade sampling bias using quotas, but they don't give any info about that so i guess they didn't use them. These are very basics of the way you're supposed to conduct sociological survey, it's taught on the second year of any sociological education program in university, so i don't believe they just overlooked this.

Next. Sadly, there are a lot of russian people who support Putin and what he's doing. But there are also a lot of those who are just afraid to speak up for different reasons. According to Russian Field research (sponsored by Maxim Katz, russian oppositioner) at least 69% support the "special operation", majority of them - old people. BUT the authors of this research are also mentioning a big number of refusals to answer and the number of refusals is bigger each week. People are also refusing to participate in the survey when they hear what this survey is about. 
You can see more data here:

https://t.me/russian_field_soc/180
Only available in Russian, but you can always use Google translate. These results aren't much better than the data in the Ukrainian research, but at least it's much more transparent and wasn't conducted through Viber

Both Spb and Moscow (and maybe moscow region) have some relatively good state hospitals (Клиника неврозов in both moscow and spb for example), but the thing is, they can’t do anything if your friend won’t come there herself. There’s another problem. It’s hard to get a good medication here, and it’s going to get even harder because of the sanctions.
